articles.title: Quoting Kenton Varda
articles.summary: I just declared a moratorium against AI-written change descriptions (e.g. PR and commit messages, also issues/tickets) from my team. AI was writing change descriptions that were worse than useless to me as I tried to review PRs: outlining details of the code that could easily be seen by looking at the code, but omitting the higher-level framing needed to understand broadly what the code is doing. — Kenton Varda Tags: kenton-varda , ai-assisted-programming , generative-ai , ai , llms
articles.title_it: Citando Kenton Varda
articles.summary_it: Ho appena dichiarato una moratoria contro le descrizioni delle modifiche scritte dall'intelligenza artificiale (ad esempio messaggi PR e di commit, anche problemi/ticket) da parte del mio team. L'intelligenza artificiale scriveva descrizioni di modifiche che erano peggio che inutili per me mentre cercavo di rivedere i PR: delineando i dettagli del codice che potevano essere facilmente visti guardando il codice, ma omettendo l'inquadramento di livello superiore necessario per comprendere a grandi linee cosa sta facendo il codice. — Kenton Varda Tag: kenton-varda , programmazione assistita da ai , generative-ai , ai , llms

articles.summary: President Donald Trump’s plan to “fill the digital potholes” and use AI to quickly redesign every government website isn’t going very well. articles.title: Verizon sent man a refurbished phone with MDM, then deleted his data remotely
articles.summary: Verizon sent one of its customers a "refurbished" phone equipped with a Mobile Device Management (MDM) profile that gave the company remote control over the device. The serious mistake raises questions about Verizon's process for preparing refurbished phones to be sent to customers. Tom Collery, the unlucky Verizon customer, called Verizon in February after having network problems, including dropped calls. Verizon responded by sending him a replacement for his phone, a Samsung Galaxy Z Flip7....
articles.title_it: Verizon ha inviato all'uomo un telefono ricondizionato con MDM, quindi ha cancellato i suoi dati da remoto
articles.summary_it: Verizon ha inviato a uno dei suoi clienti un telefono "ricondizionato" dotato di un profilo MDM (Mobile Device Management) che consentiva all'azienda il controllo remoto del dispositivo. articles.title: How long will it take to rebuild Blue Origin's launch pad? We asked some SpaceX vets.
articles.summary: A former NASA engineer named John Muratore sat on console as launch director in early September 2016 as propellant flowed onto a Falcon 9 rocket in Florida.
